verdict.rationale: Trello is a task-management product, so AI triage and prioritization of incoming work is a fair axis, but the evidence pack never documents it. The related items earn no credit: the Inbox only captures items, the general automation claim is not AI-driven prioritization, the AI feature only helps write or edit content, and the MCP server is a developer building block rather than built-in triage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI automatically triage and prioritize incoming bugs and tasks
